Class ServerSessionRegistry

java.lang.Object
it.polimi.ingsoft.mesos.server.helper.ServerSessionRegistry
public class ServerSessionRegistry extends Object
In-memory store of server-side session and lobby state, backed by a set of plain HashMaps:
  • sessionsById: session ID to its mutable ServerSessionRegistry.SessionState (connection, optional User, ServerSessionRegistry.Phase, current lobby/game ID, last pong timestamp).
  • sessionIdByNickname: authenticated nickname to its session ID, used to enforce nickname uniqueness and to look a session up by nickname.
  • reconnectGameIdByNickname: nickname of a disconnected player to the game ID it may reconnect to (the reconnect slot).
  • lobbyModels: lobby ID to its Lobby model, with nextLobbyId handing out sequential IDs.
  • activeLobbyControllers / activeGames: lobby/game ID to the LobbyController / GameController currently handling it (the routing table used to dispatch work to the right controller thread).

It exposes operations to register and unregister connections, authenticate them to a nickname, move a session through the ServerSessionRegistry.Phase state machine, manage reconnect slots, and look up the controller for a lobby or game. Read-heavy callers obtain ServerSessionRegistry.SessionSnapshot copies rather than the live ServerSessionRegistry.SessionState.

All public methods are synchronized on this instance, so the maps and the invariants between them are mutated under a single lock. Returned objects (Lobby, User, ClientConnection, controllers) are the live instances and are not made thread-safe by this class.

    • registerLobbyController

      public void registerLobbyController(int lobbyId, LobbyController controller)
      Registers a LobbyController for a specific lobby.

      The registration is protected by the registry monitor. This keeps controller mappings consistent with the rest of the registry state and avoids mixing synchronized maps with concurrent maps.

      Parameters:
      lobbyId - the ID of the lobby
      controller - the controller instance handling lobby commands

    • recordGameDisconnection

      public void recordGameDisconnection(String sessionId, int gameId)
      Opens a reconnect slot for the nickname bound to a game session.

      The game controller calls this only after the game model has accepted the disconnection. Until then the old session keeps its nickname and a new authentication with the same nickname is rejected.

      Parameters:
      sessionId - disconnected game session
      gameId - game that can accept a later reconnect from this player

    • consumeReconnectSlot

      public void consumeReconnectSlot(String sessionId)
      Consumes the reconnect slot for an authenticated session.

      The session must already be authenticated with a nickname that has a reconnect slot. The slot is removed and the session is moved into the game recorded in that slot.

      Parameters:
      sessionId - authenticated reconnecting session
      Throws:
      IllegalStateException - if the nickname has no reconnect slot
